# haymon

> haymon is a private package registry you run on your own server. It serves only the packages you've let in, so developers, CI and AI agents install exactly what you approved.

haymon mirrors public registries and private git repositories into one catalog, served through spaces that each have their own endpoint and tokens. Composer (PHP) is supported today; npm is next.

- A closed catalog: only imported packages and their dependencies are served.
- Version ranges per package: releases outside them are never mirrored.
- Private package names are only fetched from their own source.
- Archives are served from your server, each with its checksum recorded.
- Administrators manage sources, credentials, users and spaces; everyone else installs with a personal token.
- Spaces give each team or customer its own address and tokens, reaching every package or only a chosen list.
- One binary on SQLite; no database server.

haymon is in early access.
